podcast.body: This duet between Phil Collins and Earth Wind & Fire singer Philip Bailey was a massive crossover hit, reaching number two on the Hot 100, number three on the R&B chart, and number five on the Album Rock Chart. The song "exploded with Collins booming rock drums and Bailey's fluttery soul vocals," representing a significant collaboration where Collins returned a favor after years of using EWF's horn section. "their duet Easy Lover, which exploded with Collins booming rock drums and Bailey's fluttery soul vocals went to number 2 on the Hot 100, number 3 R&B and number 5 on the album Rock Chart."
